# @three-ws/tty-avatar

> A live 3D avatar in your terminal. Renders any GLB (or any three.ws avatar by id) with a software rasterizer to truecolor half-blocks or braille, animates it with moods, and reacts in real time to Claude Code hooks so your coding agent has a face.

@three-ws/tty-avatar is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/tty-avatar`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/tty-avatar/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/tty-avatar/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/tty-avatar/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/tty-avatar/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
